task: Preserve immutable publication evidence under repository path hygiene
design_justification: The user requires exact original source and delivery evidence. Five named frozen data artifacts retain original paths and are exempt only while their entire SHA-256 matches this edition. No directory-wide exclusion or live code exemption is introduced. Live README loses its workstation-specific absolute path. Source corpus, receipts and original evidence bytes remain unchanged.

validation.red: Full pre-push path hygiene rejected one live README and five frozen artifacts
validation.planned_green: Focused path hygiene check, then full standard push gates
